hero.headline: Where Educators *Make* & *Learn* Together
hero.description: Teacher Studio is a hybrid learning community for formal and informal educators interested in hands-on, maker-based learning. We gather monthly to create projects and exchange pedagogical strategies.

about.headline: Making is Learning
about.description: Teacher Studio is a hybrid learning community for formal and informal educators interested in hands-on, maker-based learning. Each month, participants make something together and share ideas for supporting maker-based learning in their own settings. The Teacher Studio is made up of school-based and out-of-school-based educators from a variety of organizations.
